name: bug
description: Existing behavior is broken; include expected behavior and reproduction evidence.

name: enhancement
description: New or improved user-facing behavior; does not imply a delivery commitment.

name: documentation
description: Documentation-only work with no product behavior change.

name: task
description: Maintenance, infrastructure, release, or operational work.

name: research
description: Discovery or design that must produce evidence and a decision before implementation.

name: epic
description: An outcome tracked through linked child issues; not a single implementation task.

name: question
description: A support or usage question; not a substitute for missing information on a bug.

name: area:launcher
description: Launcher UI, keyboard interaction, search presentation, and navigation.

name: area:capture
description: Browser or share-sheet capture, tabs, history, and capture permissions.

name: area:library
description: Local data, indexing, organization, import/export, and backup/restore.

name: area:reading
description: Article reader, offline copies, highlights, Markdown notes, and Obsidian.

name: area:cloud
description: Optional sync, hosted backup, trusted devices, and shared libraries.

name: area:website
description: Public website, downloads page, and hosted presentation.

name: area:accounts
description: Sign-in, account access, billing, pricing, and subscription transitions.

name: area:release
description: Builds, CI, packaging, signing, updates, and distribution.

name: area:privacy
description: Data handling, analytics, consent, and privacy disclosures.

name: priority:critical
description: Immediate response: active data loss or a widespread unusable release.

name: priority:high
description: Confirmed release gate or major user impact; address before normal backlog.

name: priority:normal
description: Default triaged backlog; no release date or delivery commitment.

name: priority:low
description: Explicitly deferred work, later discovery, or optional polish.

name: status:triage
description: Awaiting maintainer classification and a decision on the next action.

name: status:needs-info
description: A specific unanswered information request prevents further assessment.

name: status:blocked
description: No useful next step until a named dependency or external condition changes.

name: status:needs-validation
description: Implementation or preview exists; explicit acceptance checks remain unverified.

name: accessibility
description: A concrete barrier affecting people with disabilities; combine with a primary type.

name: good first issue
description: Small, scoped, unblocked task with clear acceptance checks and maintainer support.

name: help wanted
description: Ready for a contributor with clear scope and verification steps.

name: duplicate
description: Closed because a linked canonical issue already tracks the same work.

name: invalid
description: Closed because the report is out of scope or demonstrably not applicable.

name: wontfix
description: Closed after an explicit decision not to pursue the request.
